A new AI model just showed up  and developers immediately started putting it to work.

Meet GLM-5.3-Flash, https://t.co/sAkn3XpRc0's newest model, previously tested anonymously as Ox Alpha.

It has:

→ 320B total parameters
→ 18B active parameters
→ 1M-token context
→ Native text, image & video understanding
→ MIT-licensed weights

But the interesting part isn't the spec sheet.
Developers are already plugging it into OpenCode, Claude Code, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw to work on real coding tasks.
